title.narrative: LA IMPROVEMENT EFFICIENCY OF PUBLIC PROCUREMENT

description.narrative: This grant is to assist the GOL to implement principal items in the approved CPAR action plancomma being measures that will have a positive effect in enhancing the efficiency and transparency of public procurement in the countrycomma without overburdening the PrMO in its early stage of operation. This grant would provide funds to enable PrMO to strengthen its role in procuremnet in the following areas: (a) Enhancing Institutional Development: - Detailed study of the respective roles of government agencies involved in procurement at centralcomma provincialcomma and district levelscomma including their legal responsibilities. - Development of job description for PrMO and each agency involved in procurement. - A study tour to Poland and Czech Republic would be carried out by a senior staff member of the PrMO and international consultant. - Workshops on the proposals for the institutional development. (b) Improving the understanding of procurement procedures: - Design and assist PrMO with the implementation of practical and comprehensivecomma country-wide procurement training program for concerned government staff including a high impact initial training program. - Investigate and prepare designs for an institutionalized procurement training facility operated by PrMOcomma provide training materials and related equipment and assist in the delivery of the training programs. (c) Strengthening existing procurement IRR: - A detailed review of the 1998 IRR taking into account experience to-date and international experience. (d) Harmonizing National Procurement Guidelines and Standard Bidding Documents: - Review of existing status of harmonized documentscomma and revision as appropriate. Liaison with other major donors as work progressescomma to secure their agreement. The purpose of the Grant is to assist the Government of Lao-PDR in enhancing the efficiency and transpareny of its public procurement institutions and procedures. The activities include: 1. Enhancing Institutional Development. 2. Procurement Training Program. 3. Strengthening Procurement Implementing Rules and Regulations 4. Harmonizing National Procurement Documents.
